Class AlgoAlertScopeResolver

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAlertScopeResolver
@Service public class AlgoAlertScopeResolver extends Object
Works out which alert is evaluated against which instrument.

The evaluation used to ask only for the strategies hanging directly on the AlgoTop node and apply each of them to every instrument of the linked watchlist. An alert configured on an asset class bucket or on a single instrument - which is what the tree lets a user create, and what the alert overview shows - was therefore never evaluated at all, while a top level alert was evaluated against instruments it was never meant for. This resolver walks the three levels instead:

  • a strategy on an AlgoSecurity node applies to that node's instrument;
  • a strategy on an AlgoAssetclass bucket applies to the instruments of the bucket's own security children;
  • a strategy on the AlgoTop applies to every instrument of the linked watchlist.

Every pair is resolved once, even when the same instrument is reachable through more than one path, so an instrument that sits in a bucket and in the watchlist cannot be alarmed twice by one strategy.

Deactivation is reported rather than filtered. A pair whose strategy is switched off, and in the live scopes also a pair of a hierarchy not assigned to monitoring or with its alert disabled, comes back with active == false, because the caller has to discard its crossing baselines: dropping the pair silently would leave a stale baseline behind, and switching the alert on again would then report the move that happened while it was off.

    • resolveStandalone

      public List<AlgoAlertScope> resolveStandalone(Integer idTenant)
      The pairs of the alerts a user added straight from a watchlist or portfolio row. They hang on an AlgoSecurity without a parent, so they have no AlgoTop above them and no watchlist scope; the instrument itself names the notification. Their live switch is the strategy's alert preference.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - tenant to restrict to, or null for every tenant
      Returns:
      the standalone pairs, active and inactive
